newsitem.title: UK: ASDA sees food price inflation near 2.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: ASDA sees food price inflation near 2.5 pct.

text.p: British supermarket group ASDA Plc expects food price inflation to be around 2.5 percent in the second half, similar to first half levels, chairman Archie Norman told a press conference.
"It was around 2.5 percent in the first half (and) our feel is it will be about the same" in the second half, he said.
ASDA saw like-for-like sales growth of 10.2 percent in the first half but chief executive Allan Leighton said "we can't depend on 10 percent like-for-like forever."
He said the company was "a bit surprised" at the strong sales performance but added that management was "engineering the business so that it can still be successful without these numbers."
